answer: Pigment-marked sponsor-decay bond: a sponsor locks 80 credits and files a certificate with a cipher seal and a pigment mark on the ledger to vouch for one identity. Auditors sample 5% of filings; a fake certificate from a rented-sponsor ring slashes the bond and drops sponsor reputation to a nadir of zero, barring it. Each fake costs 80 credits plus a 60-credit onboarding, so 1,000 fakes lock 140,000 credits. An honest agent pays 80 credits once.
